audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 are marked Singed while their own text says otherwise: whys[1] 'Level 2 favours you' and whys[2] 'Level 3 is even'.
audit.why: Packet chart and mirror both read Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed, which is honest for a 46.52% lane over 892 games — Zaahen owns exactly one level.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Zaahen (rating 6/10), row 2 to Skill, in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the page builds the entire lane around 'Fling's cooldown' when the ability that actually decides it is Mega Adhesive.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1 and grounds — it is the only thing in Singed's kit that stops Zaahen's dash. Fling is 10s, Insanity Potion 100s. Zaahen's Q and E are 10s at rank 1, W 14s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: Retarget the focus onto Mega Adhesive at 17s, keep Fling as the 10s flip, and put 100s on Insanity Potion.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Singed's slots swapped throughout — Fling is written as (Q) and Poison Trail as (E), when Poison Trail is Q and Fling is E. Three real interactions are also absent: Mega Adhesive grounds Aureate Rush (his answer to your only mobility, both entry and exit), Fling into Mega Adhesive roots instead of just displacing, and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving the healing on both your Q and your R. Zaahen's E is also called 'Golden Onslaught' rather than Aureate Rush.
audit.why: Riot's text: Fling 'flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted', and Insanity Potion makes 'his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. The missing-interaction file flags all three rules for this exact matchup: dash-denied, knockup-enabler, their-antiheal-blunts-you.
audit.corrected: Fix the slot letters, state that the goo grounds your dash so it must be spent before he throws it, and put the Grievous Wounds timing on the trade advice — open before he drinks, not after.

edits.before: His flip. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 — step in the moment he spends it.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Mega Adhesive: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, and it grounds Aureate Rush. - Fling is 10s: eat it away from the goo. - Insanity Potion 100s: Grievous Wounds on his poison.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill check with just Poison Trail (E) ticks and last-hitting.
edits.after: Level 1 is a skill check with just Poison Trail (Q) ticks and last-hitting.

edits.before: Level 3 is even as Singed starts his Fling (Q) bait game and neutralizes your trades.
edits.after: Level 3 evens out as Mega Adhesive (W) grounds your dash and kills the chase.

edits.before: With 2+ items Singed's unkillable kiting and Fling (Q) make him the stronger threat.
edits.after: With 2+ items Singed's kiting and Fling (E) into goo make him the stronger threat.

edits.before: Your best window is level 2-3: before Singed builds tempo you can walk up on your Darkin Glaive (Q) and Golden Onslaught (E) and force real damage while his only tool is Poison Trail (E) ticks. After that he starts Fling (Q) baiting you under tower, so don't chase — every step you take toward him feeds his proxy game.
edits.after: Your best window is level 2: before Singed builds tempo you can walk up with The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10s) and Aureate Rush (E, 10s) and force real damage while his only tool is Poison Trail (Q) ticks. From 3 he has Mega Adhesive (W, 17s), which grounds your dash — step in before he throws it, never after.

edits.before: Singed's 6 with Insanity Potion (R) turns him into a slippery brick who runs you down or kites you into his jungler; your Final Retribution (R) can still kill him but only if you've locked him, which his Fling (Q) plus Mega Adhesive (W) slow makes very hard.
edits.after: Singed's 6 with Insanity Potion (R, 100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving the healing on both your Q and your R — open the trade before he drinks. Mega Adhesive (W) grounds your dash, so use the 850-range stab-and-pull to drag him back instead.

edits.before: Singed pulls ahead: Rylai's/Liandry's plus Rush Cap makes his Poison Trail (E) melt you as you try to trade, and his proxy farming means he's often a level up. Chasing him past his W slime is how you die — this is his spike, not yours.
edits.after: Singed pulls ahead: Rylai's and Liandry's make Poison Trail (Q) melt you as you trade, and proxy farming keeps him a level up. Chasing through Mega Adhesive (W) grounds your dash mid-chase — that is how you die, so save it for the disengage.

edits.before: Level 2 is your one clear edge — you can walk Singed down with Darkin Glaive (Q) and Golden Onslaught (E) before he snowballs tempo, so cash that trade in while his only threat is Poison Trail (E).
edits.after: Level 2 is your one clear edge — walk him down with The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Aureate Rush (E) before Mega Adhesive exists at 3, so cash that trade while his only threat is Poison Trail (Q) ticks.

edits.before: From level 3 through 6 it evens out and then slips: Singed starts Fling (Q) baiting you and proxying, and his Insanity Potion (R) at 6 makes him too sticky to punish, so stop chasing and just farm the even midgame.
edits.after: From 3 through 6 it evens out and then slips: Mega Adhesive (W, 17s) grounds your dash and Fling (E, 10s) flips you into it for a root, and at 6 Insanity Potion adds Grievous Wounds to his poison, so stop chasing.

edits.before: Once he itemizes Rylai's/Liandry's Singed is favoured — his poison shreds you in extended trades and he simply outruns your Final Retribution (R), so refuse the chase, take the towers his proxy leaves open, and only commit when he's over-extended onto your team.
edits.after: Once he itemizes Rylai's or Liandry's Singed is favoured — his poison shreds extended trades and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves your Q and R healing, so refuse the chase, take the towers his proxy leaves open, and pull him back with your W when he over-extends.

edits.before: Ignoring his Fling (Q) bait and never chasing through Mega Adhesive (W)
edits.after: Ignoring his Fling (E) bait and never dashing into Mega Adhesive (W)

edits.before: Flinging (Q) you under tower or into his jungler
edits.after: Flinging (E) you into Mega Adhesive for a root

edits.before: Kiting you through Poison Trail (E) and slime until you're low
edits.after: Kiting you through Poison Trail (Q) and goo until you're low

notes: Systematic slot error across the whole content layer: Fling was written as (Q) and Poison Trail as (E) in every string. Corrected in each line I touched — a reviewer should sweep the remaining untouched strings for the same swap. Focus retargeted from Fling to Mega Adhesive, which is the ability that actually decides this lane: it grounds Aureate Rush, Zaahen's only mobility, both in and out.
